mapper.select: SELECT fee.merchant_fee_configuration_id, fee_mode.code AS fee_mode, fee.fee_rate_bps, fee.fee_fixed FROM merchant_fee_configuration fee JOIN currency ON currency.currency_id = fee.currency_id JOIN fee_mode ON fee_mode.fee_mode_id = fee.fee_mode_id WHERE fee.account_id = #{merchantAccountId} AND currency.currency_code = #{currencyCode}
